origine_fr: 一 et 史, le scribe, qui donnait aussi le son. Le scribe qui tient les registres gouverne les hommes : c'est l'agent de l'administration. On le lit dans 官吏, les fonctionnaires.
origine_en: 一 and 史, the scribe, which also gave the sound. The scribe keeping the records governs people: the agent of government. It appears in 官吏, officials.

phrase.pinyin: Cóngqián, tā shì yī gè xiǎo lì.
phrase.en: In the old days, he was a minor official.
